team.name: Dr. Maya Patel
team.title: Director, LEAP Initiative
team.bio: Maya's research examines how adolescents develop epistemological frameworks for evaluating algorithmic information. Before joining UChicago, she spent eight years as a high school science teacher and curriculum developer.

team.name: Dr. James Okonkwo
team.title: Research Scientist
team.bio: James studies human-AI interaction with a focus on how people calibrate trust in automated systems. His methodological background spans qualitative interview research and large-scale behavioral studies.

team.name: Sofia Reyes
team.title: Curriculum Designer
team.bio: Sofia develops and tests classroom materials in partnership with Chicago-area schools. Her work integrates Universal Design for Learning principles to ensure activities are accessible across a range of learner needs.

team.name: Marcus Liu
team.title: Outreach Coordinator
team.bio: Marcus manages LEAP's partnerships with school districts, community organizations, and university programs. He coordinates professional development workshops and the annual AI Literacy Summit.
